subject: Instrumentation stabilization & alert-routing handoff for CloudedTech
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudedtech.com>, Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@cloudedtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Instrumentation stabilization & alert-routing handoff for CloudedTech

Sam / Tina —

Thanks again for the onboarding sync this morning. Per our call, I wanted to capture the immediate execution plan so both teams have clarity on next steps for observability and ops handoff. High level: we will run a two-week stabilization sprint focused on trace instrumentation, dashboard parity, and alert routing to your PagerDuty services, then transition to weekly ops checks and a shared runbook for escalations.

Immediate asks (owner in parentheses):
- Temporary tracing hook list (CloudedTech): which services are highest priority (we heard api-gateway, inference, and ingestion) (Sam)
- Attach integration checklist and runbook draft to this thread (Redwood)
- Confirm PagerDuty service IDs and desired alert severity mapping (Tina)
- Kickoff Implementation/Runbook workshop, Wednesday 11/17 @ 11:00 PT (Marissa)

I've attached the onboarding checklist and the first draft runbook. Marissa will lead the implementation directly with your engineers; Neha will own alert mapping and SLO definitions. Aditya will evaluate batching/kv-cache telemetry we should capture from the runtime for cost/latency visibility.

If this plan looks good, reply with the tracer configuration you can commit to for week 1. We'll hang a shared Drive folder for artifacts (link below).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: obs-integration-checklist.xlsx, runbook-v1.md
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudedtech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@cloudedtech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Instrumentation stabilization & alert-routing handoff for CloudedTech

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Priority services: api-gateway, inference-service (v2), batch-ingest. We can provide tracer config for those by EOD Tuesday 11/16.
- PagerDuty: Tina will share service IDs in a follow-up; the plan is to route P1–P2 to on-call; P3 as daily digest.
- Workshop: Wednesday 11/17 @ 11:00 PT works for our lead infra engineer (Luis).

Questions:
1) For tracing hooks, do you require OpenTelemetry spans only, or are there preferred Redwood tagging keys/attributes we should include to link to KV cache hits?
2) In the runbook, what is the expectation on playbook depth? Do you want run-to-resolution steps for common alerts, or just triage + owners?

Appreciate the checklist and workshop invite — we'll upload tracer snippets to the Drive folder and share service IDs later today.

—Sam Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
CloudedTech
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudedtech.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation stabilization & alert-routing handoff for CloudedTech

Sam —

Short answers to your questions, plus action items for the workshop:
1) Tracing format: OpenTelemetry is perfect. Please include a Redwood span attribute we use for cross-correlation: redwood.model_id and redwood.request_path. If you can't populate both initially, redwood.request_path is the minimum. Aditya: I'll sync separately about KV cache hit metrics/tags to capture (we'll likely want redwood.kv_hit = true/false).
2) Runbook depth: for stabilization sprint, we want: triage checklist (what to check first), owner contact, and a worked example for the highest-impact alert (e.g., inference tail latency P1). Full resolution steps can be added after week 1 once we've seen real incidents.

Workshop agenda (30–45m):
- Review current tracer snippets (Sam)
- Mapping spans -> dashboards -> alert rules (Neha)
- PagerDuty routing & severity mapping (Tina)
- Runbook template and example walkthrough (Marissa)

Please upload the tracer snippets and your PagerDuty service IDs to the Drive link Jordan included before the workshop. I've attached an alert mapping CSV template; we'll pre-populate a first pass with recommended thresholds and severity.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead — Observability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: alert-mapping-table.csv
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudedtech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation stabilization & alert-routing handoff for CloudedTech

Sam / Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per our workshop, attaching the pre-filled alert mapping and the first runbook draft. Key notes from today's session:
- Mapping decisions: inference-service P99 tail latency -> PagerDuty P1 -> on-call SRE; ingestion backpressure -> PagerDuty P2 -> data team on-call; high error-rate (5m) across api-gateway -> P1.
- We recommend adding two additional telemetry points to your OTEL spans: redwood.pipeline_stage and redwood.quantization_flag to help correlate behavioral regressions with model variants.
- Runbook expectations: triage checklist + escalation contacts + example mitigation steps for top 3 alerts. We'll iterate after two weeks of stabilizing telemetry and alert noise.

Next steps (owners):
- Sam: upload tracer snippets and service IDs (TODAY)
- Tina: confirm PagerDuty mapping and add the CloudedTech PD integration key to the shared secrets vault (Tina)
- Aditya: evaluate cost telemetry (token counts, batching effects) and propose one dashboard tile for week 1 (Aditya)
- Marissa: schedule weekly ops sync starting week of 11/22 (Marissa)

I've attached: alert-mapping-table.csv and runbook-v1.md (stub). Let us know if you'd like Redwood to open the initial PagerDuty integration on your behalf — we can create a scoped API key and send instructions.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Observability Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: alert-mapping-table.csv, runbook-v1.md
